headline: Israeli judges urge prosecutors to drop bribery charges in Benjamin Netanyahu corruption trial
label: BREAKING
caption:
Judges in Benjamin Netanyahu's corruption trial have suggested that prosecutors consider dropping the gravest bribery charges against him. According to Arab News and The Times of Israel, the court cast doubt on the corruption case and recommended reconsidering a second matter.

According to Bloomberg and CNN, the judges made the suggestions with the Attorney General in attendance, marking a massive boost for Netanyahu and a heavy blow to the prosecution.

Netanyahu allies have publicly hailed the judges' proposals to drop or reconsider the legal proceedings. According to reports, the court also suggested seeking a deal regarding the remaining aspects of the trial.
